=== COLUMN 1 ===
You know its racing
season when . .
Dedicated to all the race driver wives and girlfriends
—Adapted by Sue McKarns
The only room that gets cleaned is the camper.
You start worrying about the fice day forecast every
Tuesday.
The tire bill is bigger than your house payment.
You clean out your purse and find six ticket stubs, one
tire pressure gauge, two rolls of film and dirt.
Your weekend meals are hot dogs and popcorn.
You haven't been to your family reunion for years
because it's the first Sunday of August.
ment -ghrue

=== COLUMN 2 ===
The race car gets waxed more often than your floor.
You tell your neighbor you'll be able to come to their
yard party on Saturday . . . if it rains.
You know the number of the parts store by heart, but
have to look up your grandmother's number in the
phone book.
You celebrate your anniversary at the races.
The district sales manager you work for call you into his
office to ask you if you can get him a deal on a re-
built carburetor.
A leisure dinner is eating "in" at McDonald's rather than
the drive-thru.
The family photo album is now a box with rubber banded
groups of pictures in it.
"As soon as I get the car running, I'll fix that leaky
faucet" means: call the plumber.
The races on your driveway include 3 divisions: big
wheels, bikes and remote control cars.
Thomson
